transcript:
[SFX: opening journal cover]

DAVID (CONT’D): Inmate 3538, Joe Banks.

DAVID (slow, labored reading): “The demon lives here. I can hear its claws scraping to get into my mind. Please someone help me.”

[SFX: More flicking pages. NOT TO BE CONFUSED with the end-of-spiel sound]

DAVID (CONT’D, slow, labored reading): “The doctor says I need the treatment to stop the voices. I can’t trust him. He is one of them.” 

[SFX: More pages flicking.]

DAVID (CONT’D): Oh... It seems something happened. The handwriting goes from scrawls to being normal cursive. Last scrawl says “The demon has won. I cannot stop what will happen. I am so scared.” Then there’s one paragraph... I think... 

[SFX: Flicks through the book.]

DAVID (CONT’D): Yeah, its the last entry. Dated 24th December 1936. The day before the fire. “I sit here, in my 43rd year on this earth. For the first time, I am sincerely alone... My voices silenced... My fear has been bled out of me and fed to it... Taken from me. For the first time in my life, I have a rational mind. I see now what is happening. Something is hungry... Something is living here... It feeds on fear... Not just my fear... Everyone's. It's eating their insanity. I cannot let this continue... I will stop this... I sacrifice myself and the lives of us all to stop this...” 

MARTIN: Damn!... Did you just find a confession?

DAVID: I... Dunno...

MARTIN: Is that all it says?

DAVID: No. There... There’s more...

MARTIN: What does it say?

DAVID (Coldly): If someone is reading this, I hope I was successful... If it was and you are in this place... Run. If you stay here it can take form. Please, for the sake of your life - Run. Run now. 

Pause...

DAVID: Wow.
